
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/aifrontiers/p/21546653" title="发布于 2026-07-16 16:06">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">企业级落地方案：Docker 部署 CodeGraph 多项目统一 MCP 网关，附源码</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>原文：<a href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/9hZHi9F4Kscou8CaHhFNEg" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/9hZHi9F4Kscou8CaHhFNEg</a></p>
<p>很多人研发、产品会有这样的需求，需要频繁在多个代码仓库间切换以检索函数定义、类继承关系等语义信息。现有工具缺乏统一的知识库接入层，每个项目需独立部署 CodeGraph MCP 服务，端口管理混乱且难以维护。</p>
<p>本篇给大家分享近期的项目实战经验，实现开箱即用的多项目知识库统一访问能力。即，将一个父级目录下的多个项目批量构建 CodeGraph 知识库，并通过一个 Docker 容器、一个对外端口提供远程 MCP 访问。最终访问形态</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="http://xn--m7r540b49njsu:8000/project-a/mcp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://远程机器:8000/project-a/mcp</a></li>
<li><a href="http://xn--m7r540b49njsu:8000/project-b/mcp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://远程机器:8000/project-b/mcp</a></li>
<li><a href="http://xn--m7r540b49njsu:8000/project-c/mcp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://远程机器:8000/project-c/mcp</a></li>
</ul>
<p>话不多说，开整。</p>
<ul>
<li>github地址： <a href="https://github.com/dora-wang-x/codegraph-mcp-gateway" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dora-wang-x/codegraph-mcp-gateway</a></li>
</ul>
<h1 id="安装-codegraph-cli">安装 CodeGraph CLI</h1>
<ul>
<li><strong>去官网地址下载离线安装包</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><a href="https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/releases#release-v1.4.0" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/releases#release-v1.4.0</a></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>从本地拷贝下载文件到服务器</strong></li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash">scp codegraph-linux-x64.tar.gz username@ip_address:/home/.../Projects/codegraph_ide
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong>Linux系统下执行操作</strong><br>
新建 <code>install-codegraph.sh</code></li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash">#!/bin/bash
VERSION=v1.4.0
INSTALL_DIR="$HOME/.codegraph"
BIN_DIR="$HOME/.local/bin"

# 创建目录
mkdir -p "$INSTALL_DIR/versions/$VERSION"
mkdir -p "$BIN_DIR"

# 解压
tar -xzf codegraph-linux-x64-v1.4.0.tar.gz \
  -C "$INSTALL_DIR/versions/$VERSION" \
  --strip-components=1

# 创建版本软链接 + 全局命令
ln -sfn "$INSTALL_DIR/versions/$VERSION" "$INSTALL_DIR/current"
ln -sf "$INSTALL_DIR/current/bin/codegraph" "$BIN_DIR/codegraph"

# 检查并添加PATH（不存在才写入bashrc）
if ! echo "$PATH" | grep -q "$HOME/.local/bin"; then
  echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' &gt;&gt; ~/.bashrc
  echo "已向 ~/.bashrc 添加 PATH"
fi

echo "安装完成！执行 source ~/.bashrc 或重启终端后运行 codegraph"
</code></pre>
<p>执行以下指令</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">chmod +x install-codegraph.sh
./install-codegraph.sh
</code></pre>
<p>验证安装</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">source ~/.bashrc
codegraph --version
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong>验证</strong></li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash">which codegraph
codegraph --version
codegraph --help
</code></pre>
<h1 id="构建docker离线镜像">构建docker离线镜像</h1>
<p>现在使用的 <code>@colbymchenry/codegraph</code>（npm 版本）<strong>原生只有 stdio 模式</strong>，<strong>不自带 HTTP / SSE / TCP 远程监听参数</strong>，这里采用 <strong>mcp-remote 桥接（stdio → HTTP）</strong>方式，更适合生成环境。这里默认系统已安装npm包。</p>
<p>项目github地址  <a href="https://github.com/dora-wang-x/codegraph-mcp-gateway" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dora-wang-x/codegraph-mcp-gateway</a></p>
<p>构建docker离线镜像的目录结构</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker/
  .env
  batch_codegraph_init.sh
  codegraph.Dockerfile
  multi_project_gateway.js
codegraph-linux-x64-v1.4.0.tar.gz
install-codegraph.sh
README.md
</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><code>docker/.env</code>：保存构建和运行变量。</li>
<li><code>docker/batch_codegraph_init.sh</code>：扫描项目集合目录下一级子目录，逐个执行 <code>codegraph init</code>。</li>
<li><code>docker/codegraph.Dockerfile</code>：构建 CodeGraph MCP 远程服务镜像。</li>
<li><code>docker/multi_project_gateway.js</code>：扫描已初始化项目，为每个项目启动内部 <code>supergateway</code>，并暴露统一 HTTP 入口。</li>
<li><code>codegraph-linux-x64-v1.4.0.tar.gz</code>：CodeGraph Linux x64 离线包，放在仓库根目录作为 Docker build context 的一部分。</li>
<li><code>install-codegraph.sh</code>：在服务端安装 codegraph-linux-x64-v1.4.0.tar.gz 脚本</li>
<li><code>README.md</code>：介绍项目目标，安装步骤</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="工作方式">工作方式</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>服务端项目集合目录</strong>：</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-markdown">/srv/projects/
  project-a/
  project-b/
  project-c/
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong>容器内挂载为</strong>：</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-markdown">/workspace/projects/
  project-a/
  project-b/
  project-c/
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong>批量初始化后</strong>：</li>
</ul>
<p>通过batch_codegraph_init.sh脚本批量构建代码知识库</p>
<pre><code class="language-markdown">/workspace/projects/project-a/.codegraph/codegraph.db
/workspace/projects/project-b/.codegraph/codegraph.db
/workspace/projects/project-c/.codegraph/codegraph.db
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong>容器启动时，<code>docker/multi_project_gateway.js</code> 会</strong>：
<ul>
<li>扫描 <code>CONTAINER_PROJECTS_PATH</code> 下一级子目录。</li>
<li>默认只服务存在 <code>.codegraph/codegraph.db</code> 的项目。</li>
<li>为每个项目分配内部端口，例如 <code>9100</code>、<code>9101</code>、<code>9102</code>。</li>
<li>启动内部 <code>supergateway</code>。</li>
<li>在 <code>MCP_PORT</code> 上暴露统一入口。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>实际部署前 <code>.env</code> 文件通常只需要改</strong>：
<ul>
<li><code>HOST_PROJECTS_PATH</code>：离线服务器上的项目集合目录。</li>
<li><code>HOST_PORT</code>：对外暴露端口。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="在线环境构建镜像">在线环境构建镜像</h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>在仓库根目录执行:</strong></p>
<p>Linux/macOS shell：</p>
</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash">set -a
. docker/.env
set +a

docker build \
  -f docker/codegraph.Dockerfile \
  --build-arg NODE_IMAGE="${NODE_IMAGE}" \
  --build-arg APT_MIRROR_BASE="${APT_MIRROR_BASE}" \
  --build-arg CODEGRAPH_VERSION="${CODEGRAPH_VERSION}" \
  --build-arg CODEGRAPH_ARCHIVE="${CODEGRAPH_ARCHIVE}" \
  --build-arg SUPERGATEWAY_VERSION="${SUPERGATEWAY_VERSION}" \
  -t "${IMAGE_NAME}:${IMAGE_TAG}" \
  .
</code></pre>
<p>Windows PowerShell：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">Get-Content .\docker\.env | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -notmatch '^#' } | ForEach-Object {
  $k, $v = $_ -split '=', 2
  Set-Item -Path "Env:$k" -Value $v
}

docker build `
  -f .\docker\codegraph.Dockerfile `
  --build-arg NODE_IMAGE="$env:NODE_IMAGE" `
  --build-arg APT_MIRROR_BASE="$env:APT_MIRROR_BASE" `
  --build-arg CODEGRAPH_VERSION="$env:CODEGRAPH_VERSION" `
  --build-arg CODEGRAPH_ARCHIVE="$env:CODEGRAPH_ARCHIVE" `
  --build-arg SUPERGATEWAY_VERSION="$env:SUPERGATEWAY_VERSION" `
  -t "$env:IMAGE_NAME`:$env:IMAGE_TAG" `
  .
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>导出镜像</strong>：</p>
<p>Linux/macOS shell：</p>
</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker save "${IMAGE_NAME}:${IMAGE_TAG}" -o "${IMAGE_TAR}"
</code></pre>
<p>Windows PowerShell：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker save "$env:IMAGE_NAME`:$env:IMAGE_TAG" -o "$env:IMAGE_TAR"
</code></pre>
<h1 id="离线环境加载并运行">离线环境加载并运行</h1>
<ul>
<li><strong>加载镜像</strong>：</li>
</ul>
<p>在执行以下指令之前，需要将 .env文件中的<code>HOST_PROJECTS_PATH</code>变量改为真实的项目路径</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">set -a
. docker/.env
set +a

docker load -i "${IMAGE_TAR}"
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong>运行容器</strong>：</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker run -d \
  --name "${CONTAINER_NAME}" \
  --env-file docker/.env \
  -p "${HOST_PORT}:${MCP_PORT}" \
  -v "${HOST_PROJECTS_PATH}:${CONTAINER_PROJECTS_PATH}" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  "${IMAGE_NAME}:${IMAGE_TAG}"
</code></pre>
<h2 id="初始化-codegraph-索引">初始化 CodeGraph 索引</h2>
<p>容器启动后，对所有一级子项目批量初始化：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker exec -it "${CONTAINER_NAME}" batch_codegraph_init.sh "${CONTAINER_PROJECTS_PATH}"
</code></pre>
<p>初始化完成后重启容器，让前置网关重新扫描已初始化项目，<strong>一定要执行这步</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker restart "${CONTAINER_NAME}"
</code></pre>
<p>单个项目也可以手动初始化：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker exec -it "${CONTAINER_NAME}" codegraph init "${CONTAINER_PROJECTS_PATH}/project-a"
</code></pre>
<p>检查状态：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker exec -it "${CONTAINER_NAME}" codegraph status "${CONTAINER_PROJECTS_PATH}/project-a"
</code></pre>
<p>测试查询：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker exec -it "${CONTAINER_NAME}" codegraph explore "某个函数名或你的问题" --path "${CONTAINER_PROJECTS_PATH}/project-a"
</code></pre>
<h2 id="远程访问验证">远程访问验证</h2>
<p>检查统一网关：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl "http://远程机器:${HOST_PORT}${HEALTH_ENDPOINT}"
</code></pre>
<p>查看项目映射：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl "http://远程机器:${HOST_PORT}/projects"
</code></pre>
<p>检查某个项目后端：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl "http://远程机器:${HOST_PORT}/project-a/healthz"
</code></pre>
<h1 id="openclaudopencode远程mcp配置"><strong>OpenClaud/Opencode远程MCP配置</strong></h1>
<p>假设远程服务端有以下几个项目</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">/home/dora/Desktop/Projects/git_rep/
├── ragflow/ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 
├── openclaude/ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 
├── codegraph-mcp-gateway/ &nbsp; &nbsp;
</code></pre>
<p>下面分别给出OpenClaud/Opencode MCP配置示例</p>
<p>OpenClaud：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">{
  "permissions": {
    "allow": [     
      "mcp__codegraph-codegraph-mcp-gateway__codegraph_explore",
      "mcp__codegraph-codegraph-mcp-gateway__*",
      "mcp__codegraph-openclaude__codegraph_explore",
      "mcp__codegraph-openclaude__*",
      "mcp__codegraph-ragflow__codegraph_explore",
      "mcp__codegraph-ragflow__*"
    ]
  },
  "hooks": {
    "UserPromptSubmit": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "codegraph prompt-hook"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "mcpServers": {
    "codegraph-ragflow": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://192.168.220.128:8000/ragflow/mcp",
      "enabled": true
    },
    "codegraph-openclaude": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://192.168.220.128:8000/openclaude/mcp",
      "enabled": true
    },
    "codegraph-codegraph-mcp-gateway": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://192.168.220.128:8000/codegraph-mcp-gateway/mcp",
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}

</code></pre>
<p>Opencode：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "model": "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro",
  "provider": {
    ......
  },
  "mcp": {
    "codegraph-openclaude": {
      "type": "remote",
      "url": "http://192.168.220.128:8000/openclaude/mcp",
      "enabled": true
    },
    "codegraph-ragflow": {
      "type": "remote",
      "url": "http://192.168.220.128:8000/ragflow/mcp",
      "enabled": true
    },
    "codegraph-codegraph-mcp-gateway": {
      "type": "remote",
      "url": "http://192.168.220.128:8000/codegraph-mcp-gateway/mcp",
      "enabled": true
    }
  },
  "tools": {
    "mcp__codegraph-codegraph-mcp-gateway*": true,
    "mcp__codegraph-openclaude__*": true,
    "mcp__codegraph-ragflow__*": true
  }
}

</code></pre>
<p>OpenClaud CLAUDE.md 和 Opencode AGENTS.md路由规则，这里两个文件内容配置的完全相同</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># CodeGraph 强制使用规则

当用户问题涉及以下任一场景时，必须先使用 CodeGraph，再回答, 优先使用远程 MCP 工具：
- 查找函数、类、变量、接口、配置项的定义
- 分析调用链、依赖关系、数据流
- 解释某个项目/模块/功能的实现
- 定位 bug、修改代码、评审代码
- 询问“在哪里实现”“怎么调用”“谁调用了它”

禁止在完成 CodeGraph 初查前使用 grep、read、逐文件扫描来寻找符号或调用关系。

## 查询规则：
1. 先用较小范围查询，不要一次塞入大量关键词。
2. 每次 `codegraph_explore` 优先聚焦一个模块、文件或功能点。
3. `maxFiles` 优先使用 3 到 6，只有结果不足时再提高。
4. 如果 MCP 返回超时，缩小查询范围后重试。

## 项目索引映射

| 项目 | 路径 | CodeGraph 索引名 | 触发词 |
|---|---|---|---|
| codegraph-mcp-gateway | http://192.168.220.128:8000/codegraph-mcp-gateway/mcp | codegraph-mcp-gateway | codegraph-mcp-gateway, 项目规划 |
| openclaude | http://192.168.220.128:8000/openclaude/mcp | openclaude | openclaude |
| ragflow | http://192.168.220.128:8000/ragflow/mcp | ragflow | ragflow |

## 路由优先级

1. 如果用户给出了文件路径或当前工作目录，按路径选择索引。
2. 如果用户明确提到项目名，按项目名选择索引。
3. 如果只出现通用词，例如 RAG、检索、agent、工具调用，不要仅凭该词选择索引；应根据上下文判断，无法判断时先询问用户。
4. 不要把 `rag` 作为 openclaude 和 ragflow 的共同触发词。

## 执行流程

1. 先判断是否是代码理解/定位/调用链类问题。
2. 选择唯一 CodeGraph 索引。
3. 调用 `codegraph_search` 查找相关符号或文件。
4. 只有在搜索结果需要展开时，才调用 `codegraph_explore` 或委托 Explore 子代理。
5. 如果 CodeGraph 无结果，说明已检索失败，再使用 grep/read 作为兜底。
6. 回答时说明使用了哪个索引。
</code></pre>
<p><strong>参考资料</strong></p>
<p><strong>CodeGraph + Claude Code 图知识库实战，让 AI 编程效率翻倍</strong></p>
